title: Title of the dialog that signs the Socio mobile app in with a QR code.
title-claimed: Its title once a device scanned the code and asks to sign in.
scan: How to use the QR code. The _preview and _development forms start with which test build of the app the code is for.
waiting: {{device}} is one of the asking.* phrases ("An iPhone", "A device called “Pixel 9”"), at the start of the sentence.
allowed: Text of the Add a device dialog right after the person typed the right code, while the new device finishes signing in.
signed-in: Text of the Add a device dialog once the new device is signed in.
done: {{device}} is the device's name or one of platforms.* ("iPhone or iPad"). "Settings → Account" names a page; keep the arrow.
new-code: Button in the Add a device dialog after a request ended or expired: makes a new QR code.
not-mine: Button: the device asking isn't the person's; it refuses the sign-in.
no-app: Footer for people without the app: it's in a closed beta; an admin adds people.
send-link: Button at the bottom of the Add a device dialog: sends the person a link to install the mobile app.
link-sent: Toast: a link to get the app is on its way by email or Telegram (_email, _telegram).
asking.new: The subject of the waiting sentence when the device gave no name.
asking.ios: The subject of the waiting sentence for an Apple device.
asking.android: The subject of the waiting sentence for an Android phone.
asking.other: The subject of the waiting sentence when the device's kind isn't known.
asking.quoted: The subject when the device gave a name of its own; {{name}} is that name, quoted.
asking.named: The subject for the app's own device name, like "iPhone"; the _vowel form is for names that start with a vowel (English "An"). Use the same words for both if your language doesn't differ.
platforms.ios: Inside done and finishing, naming an Apple device.
platforms.android: Inside done and finishing, naming an Android phone.
platforms.new: Inside done and finishing when nothing names the device; lowercase.
code.label: Screen-reader label of the field for the 6-digit code the new device shows (drawn as six boxes, 3 and 3).
code.hint: Hint under the code field: where to find the 6 digits.
code.time-left: How long the request stays open; {{left}} is minutes and seconds like "1:59".
code.wrong: Error under the code field when the code typed didn't match.
code.wrong-tries: {{count}} is how many tries are left.
qr.code: Accessible name of the QR code image once it is shown; scanning it opens the Socio mobile app.
qr.show: Screen-reader label of the blurred QR code: showing it is a click.
qr.show-short: The word over the blurred QR code.
qr.works-once: Under the QR code; {{left}} is minutes and seconds like "4:59".
qr.making: Shown in the Add a device dialog while the QR code is being made.
ended.description: Text of the Add a device dialog after the request ended.
ended.refused: Shown in the Add a device dialog when the server refused to make a QR code and gave no reason.
ended.expired: Shown in the Add a device dialog when the QR code's time ran out.
ended.denied: Shown in the Add a device dialog when the request was refused because the code didn't match.
ended.not-mine: Shown in the Add a device dialog after the person chose Not my device (not-mine): the sign-in was refused.
notices.signed-in-anyway: "Not my device" is the button's name (not-mine); keep it matching that button.
notices.check-failed: Notice in the Add a device dialog when the typed code could not be checked.
notices.unreachable: Notice in the Add a device dialog when the server could not be reached.
notices.end-failed: Notice after Not my device failed; "Not my device" is the button's name (not-mine), keep it matching.
errors.link: Error toast when the link for the app could not be sent.
